programme.title: single degree Bachelor of Computing A single three year undergraduate award offered by the ANU College of Systems and Society
programme.how_found: comp.anu.edu.au/study/bachelor/ -> Bachelor of Computing -> Programs and Courses 2027 page.
programme.notes: RELATED (owner ruling): no ANU bachelor is titled Computer Science; Bachelor of Computing is the closest (Field of Education 'Computer Science'). Answers below are for the Bachelor of Computing / ANU-wide international undergraduate admission.

english.notes: The programme page refers to 'English Language Requirements for Admission' at https://policies.anu.edu.au/ppl/document/ANUP_000408; that host redirects robots.txt and pages to an SSO host (erms.anu.edu.au) that could not be reached (CONNECT 502), so the policy was not read. https://study.anu.edu.au/apply/english-language-requirements names the tests (IELTS, TOEFL iBT, Cambridge C1 Advanced, PTE Academic) without scores. A search snippet (discovery only) mentions IELTS Academic 6.5 with 6.0 in each band - not verified.

gpa.notes: Threshold is an ATAR-style selection rank, not a GPA: 'Applicants with an ANU selection rank of 80 or above are guaranteed admission' / minimum unadjusted rank 70; International Baccalaureate 31. International applicants get 'an equivalent selection rank that is calculated upon application' via a country table (https://study.anu.edu.au/apply/undergraduate-program-indicative-entry-requirements) not read for a specific qualification.

deadline.quote: Semester 1, 2027 Key dates - overview Applications are now open and will close on the 15 December 2026
deadline.notes: International undergraduate and postgraduate applications, Semester 1 2027 intake (Semester 2 2027 also offered). 'Application deadline for programs with additional selection criteria may vary.' No timezone stated.

tuition.quote: Annual indicative fee for international students $57,640.00
tuition.notes: Programs and Courses page for academic year 2027 (Australian academic year = calendar year 2027). Indicative, based on 48 units per year; 'Course fees are reviewed on an annual basis'. Services and amenities fee extra.

scholarship_exists.notes: Tuition reduction (PARTIAL): '20%, 25% or 50% off tuition fees for up to 4 years' (South East Asia 25%, Pacific 50%); no application, automatic consideration; merit-based, competitive. Excludes residents of China (incl. Taiwan, Hong Kong SAR, Macau SAR), Japan, Mongolia, Republic of Korea and further listed countries. The page does not name an intake year.

scholarship_international.quote: All eligible overseas students who have applied for admission to commence at the university, including those who have already accepted their offer of admission, will be automatically considered.
scholarship_international.notes: For overseas (international) students; residency exclusions apply (see scholarship_exists notes).
